Top-level trial scope (3 weeks)
- Goal: Validate inference latency and end-to-end cost for customer-facing recommendation flow (50k tokens/day workload simulated).
- Success metrics (pass if all are met):
  - 95th percentile latency < 200ms per request for 1–4 token responses (concurrent load up to 50 rps)
  - Inference cost ≤ $0.0025/token equivalent over validation workload
  - No PII persistence in logs; all request payloads routed to VPC-controlled ingestion during trial

- Procurement & commercial point: Evelyn Hart (evelyn.hart@redwood.com) — Informed / coordinates SOW & DocuSign

Attachments included: trial-metrics-template.xlsx (metrics we'll use), redwood-security-quickfacts.pdf (short security summary).

1) Claire to confirm procurement contact (Claire Tang) and onboarding cadence — by Wed 11/4
2) Currents to provide firewall egress whitelist window and procurement timeline — by Thu 11/5
3) Redwood infra to publish IP ranges + sample firewall rules — Rishi by Fri 11/6
4) Kickoff deployment window: week of Mon 11/9 (target) — integration work (Monica) + smoke tests (2 days)
